derived_theorem.backward: If a complete linear layout sigma has width<=k, its canonical zero-boundary trajectory has exactly the layout cut widths. Compactification tau is preorder-equivalent and width-preserving, so a compact width<=k target belongs to FS_k(V,{0}); hence FS_k(V,{0}) is nonempty.
derived_theorem.biconditional: FS_k(V,{0}) != EMPTY IFF THERE EXISTS A COMPLETE LINEAR LAYOUT OF V WITH WIDTH <= k
derived_theorem.forward: If Gamma belongs to FS_k(V,{0}), there is a realizable zero-boundary trajectory Delta with Delta preccurlyeq Gamma. Realizability gives a canonical zero-boundary trajectory of some complete linear layout as an extension of Delta. Lemma 3.4 gives width(Delta)<=width(Gamma)<=k; extensions preserve the maximum lambda, and at B={0} canonical lambda equals the layout cut intersection dimension, so that complete layout has width<=k.
derived_theorem.quantification: FOR_ALL finite subspace arrangements V over finite-dimensional vector spaces and integers k>=0

interpretation_ceiling.abstract_root_specialization: This gate proves the terminal biconditional for the mathematical full set FS_k(V,{0}).
interpretation_ceiling.engine_composition_requirement: A separate composition receipt must establish that the corrected engine's computed root set is exactly FS_k(V,{0}) by discharging every conditional O1-O6 caller premise on the actual decomposition.
interpretation_ceiling.forbidden_shortcut: Seven abstract/conditional semantic receipts do not by themselves establish the engine root identity or terminal completeness.

published_source.canonical_zero_boundary: At B={0}, L and R are zero and canonical lambda is exactly dim(prefix span INTER suffix span), hence canonical trajectory width equals linear-layout width.
published_source.full_set_definition: FS_k(V,B) consists of compact B-trajectories Gamma of width<=k for which some realizable Delta satisfies Delta preccurlyeq Gamma.
published_source.proposition_5_8: The path-width of V is at most k if and only if F_root is nonempty; its proof records V_root=V and B_root={0} and derives a complete layout from any Gamma in FS_k(V,{0}).
published_source.realizable_definition: A B-trajectory is realizable in V if some extension is the canonical B-trajectory of some linear layout of V.
